Something else unexpected is the engineering trainer. There could be some crafts, could be housing decor, or just could be utility. But, instead of sitting in Darkshire theory crafting all day, let's get out there, dust off the notebook, and start testing out some gold farms. And since we're currently sitting on skinning and leatherworking, which is what we wrapped up last episode with with the Loch Modan bear skin rugs, I kind of want to find a solid skinning farm here in Duskwood before we abandon them. And with more players leveling leatherworking for housing crafts than ever before, there is a lot of gold to be made in the leveling materials. They don't even have to be used for crafts.
